response.overview: Before becoming the notorious lawyer Saul Goodman, Jimmy McGill is a small-time attorney struggling to build a respectable career while constantly finding himself drawn toward scams, shortcuts, and questionable opportunities. As he navigates his complicated relationship with his brother Chuck, his growing partnership with Kim Wexler, and his involvement with dangerous figures in the criminal underworld, Jimmy's life gradually takes a darker turn. The series explores his transformation from a struggling lawyer into Saul Goodman while also following the rise of characters such as Mike Ehrmantraut and the growing conflict within the criminal world.
response.title: Better Call Saul
